lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: So that's the way we took, and then went down in the pit and put it right by the lake, so it, it wouldn't take that long to crush it, cuz it was close to the place where they crush.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I think Teresa's startin' be happy with you right now, cuz I think that's the truth. And then what'd you do after you put the car there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We started throwing branches and car hood on it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And then what happened? Is this when you saw him do some things to the car?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he went under the hood and did some stuff, but I didn't see 'em.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And he took the license plates off.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: All right. And then, anything else that he did?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. And then where did you go go from there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then we started walkin' up to the house.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And by the time we got back, it was close to 10:00 o'clock.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then I went home and talked to my mom a little bit and went to bed.
